## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter One Driver licenses

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Class D is the adult operator license from eighteen, Class DJ the junior version from sixteen with lower caps, and Class E the hire-carrying counterpart of D from eighteen, so age plus purpose separates all three [A01].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F04, sec01-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Commercial duty turns on either size or service: twenty-six thousand pounds of rating, fifteen-plus carried people, Article 19-A bus status, or placarded hazmat, while ordinary cars and small trailers stay non-commercial [A01].
Why it matters: group license-classes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F03, sec01-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A02
The Enhanced license proves citizenship for border crossings and domestic flights, while REAL ID only certifies the card meets federal checkpoint standards, so crossing needs the former and flying accepts either [A02].
Why it matters: group card-types; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F07, sec01-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A02
The R endorsement trips on either bulk or length, past twenty-six thousand pounds or forty feet, and its road test has no written companion, unlike the ordinary license path [A02].
Why it matters: group endorsements; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F04; confusables sec01-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A03
Form MV-44 opens the application, but the six-point identity tally with one signed paper is a separate gate, and a current New York photo card alone clears all six points [A03].
Why it matters: group application; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F10, sec01-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A05
The written test has twin bars, fourteen of twenty overall and two of four signs, so strong rules knowledge still fails without the sign minimum [A05].
Why it matters: group testing; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F19 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=10]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A05
Vision screening at twenty-forty and the written test are independent gates, and the OKTA online pre-test only works for students from fifteen years eleven months at participating schools [A05].
Why it matters: group testing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F18, sec01-F20 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=10]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A07
Junior-permit nights ban city and Long Island driving outright yet allow supervised upstate driving, while days everywhere demand a qualified supervisor, tighter in the city and on Long Island than upstate [A07].
Why it matters: group junior-charts; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F22; confusables sec01-F24, sec01-F25 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=12]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A08
The supervisor must be twenty-one or older and licensed for the vehicle everywhere, but the city and Long Island further require a parent, guardian or instructor, unlike upstate [A08].
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F22; confusables sec01-F26 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A08
Before the road test, DMV states you should have at least fifty hours of practice—including at least fifteen after sunset and a recommended ten in moderate to heavy traffic—whereas a junior learner permit must be held in valid status for at least six months before taking the road test [A08] [A09].
Why it matters: group preparation; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F28, sec01-F30 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=13]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A09
MV-278 proves the five-hour course, MV-285 proves student driver education, and MV-262 certifies supervised hours, three papers with three distinct jobs at test time [A09].
Why it matters: group paperwork; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec01-F30, sec01-F31 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A09
The DMV-certified Point and Insurance Reduction Program can reduce eligible driving-record points and lower base liability and collision insurance rates, but it does not satisfy the Safe Driving Course requirement [A09] [A10].
Why it matters: group paperwork; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F28; confusables sec01-F29, sec01-F33 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=14]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A10
When eligible, the Point and Insurance Reduction Program reduces up to four points from your driving record every eighteen months and qualifies you for at least a ten percent reduction in base liability and collision insurance premiums for three years, without meeting the Safe Driving Course requirement [A10] [A09].
Why it matters: group paperwork; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F33 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=15]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A11
Licensed-junior nights ban the city, shuttle school and farm trips on Long Island, and allow job or school runs upstate, a three-way split that mirrors but never matches the permit chart [A11].
Why it matters: group junior-charts; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F24; confusables sec01-F36 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=16]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A11
Solo job runs need MV-58A employment proof, or upstate an employer letter, while solo school runs need a letterhead enrollment letter, so the destination picks the paper [A11].
Why it matters: group junior-proofs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F35 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=16]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A12
A Class M or MJ motorcycle or moped learner permit or junior license allows no passenger except a supervising driver licensed for the same class, who must maintain general supervision and control within one quarter mile and should ideally keep the rider in sight [A12].
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F22; confusables sec01-F37 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=17]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A13
United States and Canadian newcomers surrender and test lightly, other-country newcomers test fully, young visitors obey both states, and nobody under sixteen drives at all [A13].
Why it matters: group new-residents; difficulty high; prereq sec01-F01; confusables sec01-F40, sec01-F41 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=18]
